segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-to-oily skin report the lightweight, non-greasy texture works well and hasn't caused breakouts for them.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one describing crepey texture, report it leaves their skin soft, radiant, and hydrated, though one still recommends following up with a moisturizer.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or oily-combination skin describe it as a game-changer that hydrates without a greasy feel.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin mostly report no irritation from the fragrance-free formula, though a few describe a sore rash or allergic reaction after only a couple of uses.
segments.mature: A 71-year-old reviewer with longstanding large pores reported no improvement and more breakouts after two bottles, while reviewers in their 40s and 50s report firmer, smoother, more radiant skin with regular use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers, including some using it specifically for anti-aging, report visibly softer fine lines, more filled-in forehead lines, and firmer, tighter-looking skin within one to a few weeks of use; one 71-year-old reviewer, however, saw no improvement in her longstanding skin concerns after finishing a full bottle.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including some with dry skin, report the serum leaves skin hydrated, plump, and glowing, often noting the effect from the first few uses; no reviewer reported it failing to hydrate, though one felt the formula itself was too watery for the price.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report no redness, burning, or irritation, including on sensitive skin, but a handful describe serious adverse reactions - a sore, inflamed red rash, a burning sensation requiring a steroid pack, or allergic swelling - after just one or two applications.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports using it the day after retinol to help restore her skin barrier, with good results.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers, mostly describing acne-related marks, report their dark spots and discoloration visibly faded and their complexion looked clearer after a few weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts or irritation, and a couple with acne-related marks say their skin cleared up; however, one reviewer who had never had acne broke out badly within three days of starting the product, and another longtime large-pore sufferer reported more breakouts on her second bottle.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers report the serum tightens the look of enlarged pores and leaves skin feeling less greasy; one longtime sufferer of large, clogged pores, however, saw no improvement even after a second bottle.

extraits.titre: My skin looks firmer, smoother, and has a healthy glow!
extraits.texte: I’m 45 years old and have been very consistent with my skincare routine for years. I’m always looking for products with effective ingredients, so when I came across this serum with NAD+, peptides, and niacinamide, I decided to give it a try. The first thing I noticed was the texture. It’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling sticky, which is very important since I have combination to oily skin. I use it after cleansing and before my moisturizer on both my face and neck. After several weeks of consistent use, my skin feels much more hydrated, softer, and noticeably brighter. I’ve also noticed it looks firmer and more refreshed, especially in the mornings. It’s not an overnight miracle, but with regular use, the improvement is definitely noticeable. Another thing I appreciate is that it layers well with the rest of my skincare routine without causing irritation or breakouts. If you’re looking for a serum with advanced ingredients that helps improve hydration, firmness, and overall skin appearance, I definitely recommend giving this one a try. I’ll continue purchasing it.

I’m impressed by the EQQUALBERRY NAD+ Peptide Boosting Smoothie Serum. I’m 52 and have sensitive, rosacea-prone skin, so it can be difficult for me to find anti-aging products that don’t irritate my skin. This serum is a wonderful in that regard. It is fragrance free, which is surprisingly difficult to find in skin care. Its moisturizing properties offer my skin a good amount of hydration, and the ingredients are all proven anti-aging fighters. My skin is smooth and soft after using this serum, and it gives me a nice glow. The serum comes in a two pack, and a little bit of the serum goes a long way, so each bottle will last a long time. Therefore, even though this product does is expensive, I do believe it offers good value for the money for those reasons. I’m very happy with this order.
